title: AMD Ryzen 5 5500X3D CPU US$159.74 (~A$227.66) Delivered @ Binary Tech Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: AMD Ryzen 5 5500X3D CPU US$159.74 (~A$227.66) Delivered @ Binary Tech Store AliExpress

[Erwark] Good upgrade for people with 1000-3000 series Ryzen who want to game.
[antmcbane] not convinced it would be over an r7 honestly. but fwiw i went from a 3600 to a 5500x3d and saw noticeable game improvements.
[Quinefer] FWIW, I went from a 3700x to a 5600 and saw noticeable game improvements - didn't regret that move one bit and wish I had done it sooner.
I then went from a 5600 to a 5500x3d, saw noticeable improvements but it's very game dependent. I got it before the 5800x3d anniversary edition was announced, so I do kinda wish I had a 5800x3d instead given that I will be holding on to AM4 for quite awhile longer.
[Fitzu] temped. wishing for sales on 5700x3d or 5800x3d
[Kevin Bacon] Went from 3700X to 5700X3D and it was a huge upgrade for games like Total War, Space Marine 2 and Battlefield. 1% Lows are much higher, less stutter overall.
I'd trade 2 less cores for that kind of improvement, unless you need productivity like encoding and render.
[straustea] Anyone know why there aren't any 5800X3D deals popping up on AliExpress like there were for the 5700X3D a few years ago?
[vanyellow] no stock
5800x3d fails / becomes 5700x3d
5700x3d fails / becomes 5600x3d
…. etc etc
[tonyjzx] 10th anniv., 5800x3d is very new and isnt it retail only?
[unbelievable duck] Anyone with a 5500 bothered to upgrade to this?
[SirKindUsername] Would anyone enlighten me why go for this instead of 5600X processor from local stock?
[Bunnyburger] I have a 5600x . worth upgrading to 5500x3d?
[Fergy1987] I went for the 5600x instead of this to upgrade my 3600.. figured I didn't want to spend this much to upgrade old tech
[mayo] 5500x3d is a little faster for gaming.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=02N0bTasuD4
[omghi2u] got a ryzon 5 2600…worth an upgrade? and will it fit in my mobo?
[Wooluff] Yes, and yes. You might need to update your bios in your motherboard though which is usually pretty straightforward, but as always, check the manufacturer website for compatibility.
I went from a 3600 to this 5500x3d (different seller), and it's been fantastic for games.
[poiterbad] Better to stack with the UK topcashback? 25% uncapped
